recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-16799 unless the CDS work group later chooses to bring detailed CDS Hooks profile or mapping content back from the implementation guide.
issue_request: FHIR-16799 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification. The issue questioned whether CDS Hooks support should change the CDS Hooks element mapping around PlanDefinition.data-requirement or add a specific field, and the approved resolution was to add documentation clarifying that any ECA Rule could potentially be exposed as a CDS Hooks service.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly names FHIR-16799. The same documentation family appears to have been applied by the November 2018 CDS Hooks/PlanDefinition work: commit 1c7aa38, linked from FHIR-18844, added CDS Hooks guidance for PlanDefinitions and described PlanDefinition as an event-condition-action rule pattern that can be integrated with CDS Hooks; commit 60a763e cleaned up the same page's CDS Hooks request/response mappings.
additional_context: The old RequestGroup artifact named by the Jira issue is no longer active; current source uses RequestOrchestration, with PlanDefinition, GuidanceResponse, and RequestOrchestration active in source/fhir.ini. Current Clinical Reasoning pages define ECA rules as PlanDefinitions, show applying an ECA rule with $apply, and say Clinical Reasoning content can be exposed through a wrapper around PlanDefinition $apply for CDS Hooks. Later FHIR-53085 moved detailed CDS Hooks profiles and mappings to the Using FHIR Clinical Reasoning with CDS Hooks IG while retaining concise core guidance, and that later audit is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current core source already conveys the approved clarification in active built pages, updated for the RequestGroup-to-RequestOrchestration rename and the later move of detailed CDS Hooks material to the implementation guide.
